key.description: Starts with the solution's key and a hyphen, such as diesel-dashboard.

icon.description: The glyph of the app's icon, one of those docs/apps.md lists, such as fuel. Without one the icon shows the name's initials.

color.description: The colour of the app's icon, such as #b45309. Without one the name chooses it.

source.description: The app's TSX file, beside this one.

parameters.description: Name what the solution declares as $collection:<key>, $type:<key> and $setting:<name>.
